new_findings.kind: construction invariant / positive determination gap: ExtGState /SMask /G is a viewer content role the crate never follows
new_findings.file_line: src/show_text.rs:1047-1061 (content_role_streams: /Subtype /Form, /PatternType 1 or own /Resources only); src/show_text.rs:738-748 and src/redaction.rs:337-364 (gs reads /Font and /LW only, never /SMask); src/sanitized_save.rs:784-800 (page_classes closes only over Do); src/canon.rs:326-337 (canonicalize plans appearance roots and content_role_streams only); src/sanitized_save.rs:983-993, :1012-1015 (other streams: run_unreached with the lenient tokenizer, exempt from the canonical check); src/syntax.rs:200-207 + src/content.rs:100-107 (lenient keyword = every regular byte)
new_findings.evidence: pdf.js da95557 evaluator.js:1191-1210 (setGState /SMask dict) -> handleSMask :924-955 -> buildFormXObject(resources, smask.get('G'), ...) :475-581: no /Subtype check, resources = the G stream's own /Resources or the CALLER's (:565), state = clone of the current one; WITHOUT /Group the G operators go straight into the page's operator list and are painted (:557-560, :579-581; canvas.js:1272 activates no mask), with /Group they become the soft mask. (a) Region: page 'q 1 0 0 1 0 0 cm /GS1 gs Q BT /F1 12 Tf 72 300 Td (Public) Tj ET', /ExtGState << /GS1 << /SMask << /S /Luminosity /G 30 0 R >> >> >>, object 30 = << /Subtype /Form /BBox [0 0 612 792] /Resources << /Font << /F1 Helvetica >> >> >> drawing 'BT /F1 12 Tf 100 700 Td (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET', no /Group; redact_and_save region [90 690 200 715]: the selector never enters 30 (nothing removed, nothing marked, report complete), 30 is canonicalised and walked only as a Stray root (not in page_classes), residual pass 0, no needle: region_cleared() and is_proven() true while pdf.js paints SECRET-ALPHA in the region. (b) Construction: object 30 = << /Length n >> (no /Subtype, no /Resources) drawing 'BT /F2 24 Tf 100 100 Td <010203040205060708090A07>TjET' with page font /F2 = Helvetica + /Differences [1 /S /E /C /R /T /hyphen /A /L /P /H], and the page also draws (SECRET-ALPHA) in the region (removed: needle). 30 is kept byte for byte, read by run_unreached: read_keyword makes 'TjET' one unknown operator (pdf.js parser.js:1347-1372 splits it into Tj, ET via knownCommands = opMap, evaluator.js:5388-5393), so nothing is recorded or opaque; its bytes and operands hold no spelling of SECRET-ALPHA and it has no resources_used (no code-spelling scan); it is exempt from the canonical check: is_proven() true while pdf.js paints SECRET-ALPHA at (100,100). NotProven::NonCanonicalContent catches neither. The V4-06 verdicts content.rs:73/:318/:339 and show_text.rs:558 ('no viewer draws such a stream') are therefore false.
new_findings.remediation: Treat the /G of every ExtGState /SMask dictionary as a form drawn at the gs (caller's resources and font when it has no /Resources): the selector enters it (remove, or mark RegionIncomplete / refuse since a mask's effect on later painting is not computed), the walker walks it in the drawing root's role, canonicalize rewrites it and the proof checks it canonical; fail closed for any stream that a decoded ExtGState /SMask reaches but the crate cannot read. Independently, in a redaction output make every decoded non-raster stream that tokenize() accepts and that holds a text-showing or unknown operator NotProven unless it is canonical, or split keywords like pdf.js. Tests for (a) and (b).

new_findings.kind: canonical rewrite changes what is drawn: inline-image keys override /Subtype /Image
new_findings.file_line: src/canon.rs:216-237 (image_xobject sets /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image at :218-219, then copies EVERY inline key with set_key at :233, which replaces an existing key: src/syntax.rs:58-63); src/canon.rs:380-397 (drawn by Do /HskImN)
new_findings.evidence: pdf.js draws BI..EI as an inline image whatever its dictionary holds (parser.js:537-553 makeInlineImage stores every key; evaluator.js:1909-1916 buildPaintImageXObject isInline). Page 'BT /F1 12 Tf 100 700 Td (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET BI /W 45 /H 1 /BPC 8 /CS /G /Subtype /Form /BBox [0 0 612 792] ID' + one space + the 45 data bytes 'BT', LF, '/F1 12 Tf', LF, '100 100 Td', LF, '(SECRET-ALPHA) Tj', LF, 'ET', LF + ' EI', region [90 690 200 715]: the source shows a 45x1 grey image at the origin; the selector removes the Tj (needle) and keeps the BI (unit square outside the region); canonicalize makes an XObject whose inline /Subtype /Form replaced /Image, drawn by '/HskIm0 Do'. On the saved file every viewer executes it as a form with the page resources (pdf.js evaluator.js:1820-1840): SECRET-ALPHA is DRAWN at (100,100). Proof: the walker enters HskIm0 by Do (Kept role), the data is exactly canonical, so the needle is a kept-text collision (no hit, raw bytes explained), the residual pass finds the form text outside the region: region_cleared() and is_proven() true while the redaction itself created visible text holding the removed string.
new_findings.remediation: Build the XObject dictionary only from the inline-image keys of ISO 32000-2 Table 91 (BPC CS D DP F H IM I W, Intent, L skipped) and refuse any other key (redaction refusal or NonCanonicalContent), or at least set /Type /Subtype after copying and refuse /Subtype /Type /Resources /BBox /Matrix /Group /OC /SMask; test with /Subtype /Form in an inline dictionary.

new_findings.file_line: src/redaction.rs:613-618 (Interp::parse returns parse_strict(..)?.ops and drops Parsed::inline_ambiguous); src/canon.rs:252-266 (parse_stream ignores it) and :378-398 (moves the bytes into an image XObject); only consumers: src/show_text.rs:482, :605
new_findings.evidence: pdf.js parser.js:202-336 findDefaultInlineStreamEnd ends unfiltered (and Flate/LZW/RL) inline data at the first E,I,(SP|LF|CR) whose next 15 bytes are ASCII and whose next tokens form a known operator with its operand count. Page 'BI /W n /H 1 /BPC 8 /CS /G ID' + space + n data bytes 'x EI BT /F1 12 Tf 100 700 Td (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET' + ' EI', region [90 690 200 715]: pdf.js ends the image after 'x ' and draws SECRET-ALPHA in the region; the crate takes all n bytes (content.rs:356) and sets inline_ambiguous (:329-334), which the selector ignores: nothing removed or marked (the image's unit square is outside the region), report complete; canonicalize copies the n bytes into an image XObject, so the saved file has no inline image (no ambiguity) and no needle: region_cleared() and is_proven() true while 'BT /F1 12 Tf 100 700 Td (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET' stays as plain bytes of the saved file. new_findings.kind: V4-01/V4-02 hostile sizes (time, uncancellable) in R10 code
new_findings.file_line: src/content.rs:357-374 (raster inline image: codec_signature re-scans the whole prefix, raster.rs:176-216, for EVERY 'EI' candidate); src/canon.rs:384-393 (HskImN loop: linear get_key over each holder's /XObject dict per candidate); src/canon.rs:124-156 (canonical output not charged to any budget)
new_findings.evidence: (a) An inline /DCT image whose entropy data holds 'EI ' every few bytes costs O(candidates x length) per strict parse (1 MiB with about 3e5 candidates is about 1e11 byte steps), with no budget charge and no check_cancel inside parse_strict; the same stream is parsed by the selector, canonicalize and the walker. (b) A resource dictionary pre-filled with /HskIm0../HskIm(N-1) (N about 1e6 fits max_nodes 16M / max_bytes 64 MiB) makes the name search O(N^2) with no cancellation poll (same pattern pre-exists at redaction.rs:581-596 HskRdN). (c) write_op turns a name byte into #xx (3x) and binary strings into hex (2x): output up to 3x the decoded input, not charged (V4-02 asks for the aggregate check before allocating).
new_findings.remediation: Find the raster end in one pass (codec structure scan once, then the first EI after the structural end), charge candidate scans to the budget and poll the token; pick HskImN by one pass over the holder's keys (max suffix + 1) or a set; charge canonical output to max_decoded_total; dims_u32_max / aggregate_over_budget tests for both.
